FAQ

Questions Students Ask Us

Quick answers to common questions. Can’t find yours? Just message us.

Still have a question?

Ask on WhatsApp (opens WhatsApp in a new tab)
How does Achieve Aboard help me study abroad?

We guide you through each stage: choosing a destination, university and course; preparing and submitting your applications and documents; understanding visa requirements; and planning accommodation, travel and arrival. You can start with a free conversation on WhatsApp.

Is the first consultation free?

Yes. Send us a message on WhatsApp, tell us about your goals, and we will talk through your options with no cost for that first conversation.

Can you guarantee admission or a visa?

No. Admission decisions are made by universities, and visa decisions are made by government authorities. What we can do is help you choose suitable options, prepare complete and accurate applications, and understand each requirement so you can apply with confidence.

Which countries can I choose from?

Our current study destinations are Malaysia, Australia, UK, Canada, USA, Europe, Japan and South Korea. If you are considering another country, ask us and we will let you know how we can help.

I am not sure which course to study. Can you help?

Yes. Tell us about your interests, previous studies and career goals, and we will suggest study areas to explore and help you compare programs. Tap “Find My Course” to start a chat.

What documents will I need?

Requirements depend on the country, university and course. Commonly requested items include your passport, academic transcripts and certificates, proof of English proficiency (where required), a personal statement and financial documents. We will give you a checklist that matches your chosen program.

Do you support me after I arrive?

Yes. Our services include arrival support and student support after arrival, so you have a familiar point of contact while you settle in.

How can I contact you?

The fastest way is WhatsApp on +60167217612. You can also email achieveaboard4@gmail.com or send an inquiry using the form on our Contact page.
